groups.activity: hunt, fish or bounty for Ostron standing

rows.label: Visitor rank-up
rows.note: 22,000 standing, 25,000cr; unlocks the Marquise Veridos and Fersteel Alloy refine blueprints

conditions: The Strike blueprint is buyable at Neutral, but its two refine blueprints are Visitor-locked — don't buy blueprints for materials you can't make yet.

groups.activity: buy the Strike, Grip and Link blueprints
conditions: Peye makes the Machete form; most build threads favor it over the two-handed Polearm, whose slide-attack builds fell off after Melee 3.0.
Jayap and other two-handed Grips need Visitor rank, so Peye is also the cheaper pick if you're building this before Visitor.
Both are reusable blueprints, so this cost is one-time even if you build more Zaws later.
bonuses: Suumbaat pays 75 Ostron standing per Veridos gem turned in, which helps fund the Visitor and Trusted rank-ups.

rows.label: Breath of the Eidolon
rows.note: no enemy drops it; bounty reward only

conditions: Boosters do nothing for this reward — resource and drop-chance boosters do not apply to bounty rewards.
Only 1 is needed for Cyath, so one successful Stage 1 roll covers the whole Strike with four spares.

groups.activity: mine, fish and refine the rest of the build

rows.label: Veridos
rows.note: green gem, blue veins; refines into 6+ Marquise Veridos

rows.label: Fish Scales
rows.note: Strike; carve any Plains fish at Fisher Hai-Luk

rows.label: Ferros
rows.note: red/ore veins; refines into 20 Fersteel Alloy with Plastids and Rubedo

rows.label: Alloy Plate
rows.note: Peye Grip; common resource, not Plains-specific

rows.label: Khut-Khut Venom Sac
rows.note: Jai Link; fillet Khut-Khut or loot Thumpers

conditions: Fersteel Alloy's own recipe (1,000cr, 20 Ferros, 400 Plastids, 200 Rubedo per batch of 20) means one batch covers the Strike exactly.

rows.label: Cyath Strike
rows.note: 5,000cr, 1 Breath of the Eidolon, 55 Fish Scales, 6 Marquise Veridos, 20 Fersteel Alloy

rows.label: Peye Grip
rows.note: 20 Iradite, 50 Fish Oil, 850 Alloy Plate, 60 Pyrotic Alloy

rows.label: Jai Link
rows.note: 10 Nistlepod, 20 Pyrotic Alloy, 2 Condroc Wing, 5 Khut-Khut Venom Sac

rows.label: gild
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp + 5,000 Ostron standing, Trusted rank; resets to rank 0

rows.label: level to 30 again
rows.note: this pass is what pays Mastery

conditions: An ungilded Cyath gives no Mastery.
A Machete built from a Cyath Strike has a known Heavy Slam damage-falloff bug (wiki-listed).
Once forged the Zaw can never be disassembled.
bonuses: If going for MR, build every Zaw strike together — the refined gems, alloys and standing cover all of them at once.

disclosures.title: Machete over Polearm
disclosures.body: Most build threads favor the one-handed Machete; slide-attack Polearm builds fell off after Melee 3.0, so a slide-crit Riven reroll was the advice instead.
